primary_content.text: Discover Koh Tao’s best-kept secret. A secluded beachfront resort offering private access to a thriving coral reef. Set above the shoreline and surrounded by lush tropical greenery, our resort offers sweeping ocean views, vibrant marine life, and a deep connection to nature, all designed for guests who value serenity, scenery, and space to unwind.

main_topic.h_title: Escape to June Juea Beach: The Peaceful Alternative to Sairee Beach
main_topic.main_title:
Pinnacle Koh Tao Resort:
Cliffside Sunset Sanctuary on June Juea Beach
main_topic.author: Pinnacle Koh Tao Resort

primary_content.text: While Sairee Beach is famous for its nightlife and busy crowds, Pinnacle Koh Tao Resort on June Juea Beach offers a completely different island rhythm. Nestled in a quiet, untouched bay on the southwestern coast, our guests enjoy absolute tranquility. There are no loud beach clubs or massive tourist boats—just the sound of the waves and an unobstructed front-row seat to Koh Tao’s most beautiful sunset.

main_topic.h_title: Cliffside Accommodations Designed for Unmatched Ocean Views
main_topic.main_title:
Pinnacle Koh Tao Resort:
Cliffside Sunset Sanctuary on June Juea Beach
main_topic.author: Pinnacle Koh Tao Resort

primary_content.text: Pinnacle Koh Tao Resort features 45 private accommodations organically nestled along the lush tropical hillside of June Juea Beach. Our collection includes 22 Seaview Villas, 20 cozy Hotel Rooms, and 3 spacious Family Rooms—each designed to offer a breathtaking panoramic view of the Gulf of Thailand. Every room comes equipped with a private balcony, providing guests with a front-row seat to Koh Tao’s most spectacular evening sunsets in absolute tranquility.
20 Hotel Rooms (Tropical Comfort)
22 Seaview Villas (Cliffside Experience)
3 QUADRUPLE Rooms (Spacious Getaways)

Located at the resorts most elevated point, our Hotel Rooms with Sea View offer an awe-inspiring panoramic view over the resort’s landscape and the Gulf of Thailand. These rooms are mostly furnished in a contemporary design blended with lively colors and are composed as double and twin rooms.

Sea View Villas are decorated in a contemporary style with an eye for comfort – nestled within tropical gardens set on the lush hillside of Koh Tao Island, overlooking the Gulf of Thailand. Seaview Villas make for a more romantic choice accommodation. These are especially recommended for couples and Honeymooners.

Welcome to our Quadruple Room/Family Room, ideally situated at the heart of the hotel, just steps away from the pool and a stone’s throw from the beach. Designed for families, these spacious rooms comfortably accommodate up to 4 guests, featuring a large bed for parents and bunk beds for the little ones. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Gulf of Thailand from your room, creating the perfect backdrop for cherished family moments

primary_content.text: Yes! Our resort sits directly on the shallow reef flat of June Juea Beach. You can swim out just a few meters from the shore to encounter resident green sea turtles and juvenile blacktip reef sharks in their natural habitat.

Yes, the resort is organically terraced along a steep cliffside to ensure every room gets a panoramic sea view. Walking to our Sea View Villas involves steep inclines and stairs, which is perfect for active travelers but might not be suitable for individuals with mobility challenges.
We provide a free round-trip shuttle/pier transfer from Sairee Beach & Mae Haad Pier (an 8 to 10-minute drive)
for all registered guests during arrival and departure times.
